title: Rethinking Perplexity: Revealing the Impact of Input Length on Perplexity Evaluation in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM perplexity and accuracy across varying sequence lengths (1K to 8K tokens) using a framework called LengthBenchmark to demonstrate how input length systematically alters performance metrics.
Comparing perplexity scores generated by a standard sliding window approach versus a non-sliding (direct accumulation) method to reveal systematic distortions in cross-model comparisons.
